description:
Find what data Tako holds on an entity or a metric, and the canonical name it holds it under.

Best for: coverage questions themselves, or a metric's canonical name before a priced search. Put a company, person, or place in `q` to list the metrics tracked on it; put a metric in `q` to list the entities it covers. Add `metric` when you know the measure — you get the resolved pair and a ready-to-run `next_call`.

Search on the canonical names it returns, not your own phrasing — `tako_search` matches the graph's names, not yours. A name here means the graph tracks it, not that a card exists. If the follow-up search comes back empty, say Tako has no card for it rather than rephrasing the query. Hand a node id to `tako_graph_related` to see what else connects to it.

label.description: NER label to prefer for `q` — a boost, not a filter. Set it when you can categorize the term: company → ORG, place → GPE, person → PERSON. It never applies to `metric`.

limit.description: How many candidates to resolve for each of `q` and `metric`. Raising it widens what the tool considers, not just what it shows: a deeper metric can become the one `next_call` names.

metric.description: The measure, when you already know it — "gross margin", "capex". Supplying it resolves the entity+metric pair directly; omit it to browse everything the entity has.

q.description: The entity or metric to look up by name — "Carnival", "United States", "Nvidia". Put the measure in `metric`, not here.

types.description: Narrow resolution to one kind, an entity or a metric. Omit to resolve both.

name: tako_available_data

candidates.description: The other nodes `q` resolved to, best first.

name.description: Canonical graph name — search on this.

type.description: entity or metric; also what `coverage` counts.

found.description: Whether Tako holds matching data; `verified` says on what evidence.

guidance.description: The verdict, and the one next action.

matches.description: The nodes whose coverage was drilled, best first.

total.description: Entries in all, not entries listed.

truncated.description: More entries exist than are listed.

filter.description: The `metric` phrase that narrowed this list. When set, `total` counts only matching entries.

name.description: Canonical graph name — search on this.

type.description: entity or metric; also what `coverage` counts.

next_call.description: A follow-up search in canonical names. Null when no target is unambiguous.

verified.description: What was checked. `pair`: the metric is on the entity's own list. `coverage`: a list was drilled. `unlinked`: the list was checked, the metric is absent. `resolution`: names resolved only.

title: Tako: Available Data
